source_state: Working tree based on baseline_commit (v0.5.6) with uncommitted compressor changes: a shared SIMD prefilter of the sixteen distance-cache probes (compressor::core::cache_probe) used by the q10/q11 Zopfli update_nodes loop and by the q7-q9 greedy bucket matchers (probe_derived_distances); dictionary words compared against the input as one u8x32 in all_matches::find_all, now a #[simd] entry point (q10/q11); and an exact early exit in is_mostly_utf8 (q10/q11). Compressed output is byte-identical to baseline_commit. Decoder sources unchanged from baseline_commit.

limitations: Single WSL2 host; frequency, thermal state, and host scheduling uncontrolled.
Fixed encoder order; confidence bounds describe sampling variation, not all environmental bias.
Cold native APIs; retained workspace and streaming are measured by the root benchmarks.

Eight benchmark processes ran at once on separate cores and shared the last-level cache, memory bandwidth and the package's turbo budget; absolute timings are below a single-core sweep and latency cases of tens of nanoseconds (empty input) move most. Ratios to C are the comparable quantity.
Host idle before the sweep: load average 0.13/0.13/0.06 four minutes after a reboot (10:01:59 MSK), no other benchmark, build, test or fuzzing process running.

Cases whose ratio to C fell more than 5% below the 2026-10-02 run were re-timed on the same lanes (39 cases); the confirmed ones were checked with callgrind against v0.5.6 (dba6a473) and 5f39a1d0: instruction counts and page faults match within 0.7%, so those shifts come from the host, not from the code.
